findings.passage: “For over a decade, Wisconsin’s voter ID law has been in place and served our state well,” said Krug. “Passage of this amendment today ensures that Wisconsin voters have the opportunity to protect voter ID in the April election and prevent an activist State Supreme Court from throwing out the will of the people.”
findings.note: Press release from his office on the Assembly vote on the voter ID constitutional amendment (second passage, 54-45). Passage copied from the PDF text via pdftotext of the downloaded file.

findings.passage: “Making sure Wisconsin residents can have full confidence in their elections is important,” added Krug. “I was proud to vote in favor of this common sense amendment for the integrity of our elections.”
findings.note: Second quote in the same release, about the same amendment.
